items.title: Demna calls on Tom Brady, Xiao Zhan, Ningning, Shawn Mendes for Gucci Primavera campaign
items.summary: Trade press reports Gucci unveiled its Primavera global campaign on August 25, its first advertising since Demna's runway debut, spreading cultural weight across ten faces (Xiao Zhan, Jin, Ningning, Tom Brady, Alex Consani, Shawn Mendes, Rico Nasty, Lee Young-ae, EsDeeKid, Tarzzan) photographed by Michal Chelbin, explicitly courting audiences outside core fashion media such as Brady's older, wealthier male fanbase.

items.title: Kering stock faces China luxury slowdown as Gucci beauty license shifts
items.summary: German financial outlet reports Kering shares fell to EUR255.45 (-1.75% that day, -13.6% YTD) on August 20 as fresh data showed China's 25 biggest luxury labels' sales fell over 10% in July amid a wealth-tax crackdown, compounding uncertainty as Kering finalizes redeeming Gucci's beauty license from Coty for $400m ahead of a 2027 handover to L'Oreal.

items.title: Gucci: en passe d'amorcer son retournement?
items.summary: French trade outlet's analysis of Kering's H1 2026 results notes Gucci revenue of EUR2.757bn (-9% reported, -5% comparable), with Western Europe DTC sales down 5% in H1 and down 8% in Q2 specifically due to a drop in Asian and Middle Eastern tourist spending in European stores, even as CEO Bellettini's sequential improvement narrative gains credibility among analysts.

items.title: Miu Miu scala 29 posizioni, Gucci scivola al quinto posto nel ranking Brand Finance Italy
items.summary: Italian financial daily reports Gucci fell from third to fifth place in the Brand Finance Italy 100 2026 ranking as Miu Miu surged 29 spots; Brand Finance cites weakened image/reputation on international markets for Gucci and Prada, driving a rating downgrade and double-digit brand-value decline tied to slowing Chinese demand and shifting luxury preferences.

items.title: Gucci just unveiled its star-studded Primavera campaign
items.summary: Handbag-collector community outlet covers the Primavera campaign cast and styling choices for an audience that follows Gucci leather goods closely; framed within PurseForum's ongoing community discussion threads on Gucci quality and value perception rather than pure celebrity-casting news.

items.title: Gucci quality concerns thread
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum community thread where members detail recurring quality complaints -- shoes falling apart, watch movements failing, zippers breaking on bags -- alongside comments that repeated use of the same core styles (belts, slides) since 2017 has eroded the brand's exclusivity; thread remains active with new posts in the past week.

items.title: Gucci unveils Primavera campaign on Instagram
items.summary: Official Gucci Instagram post announcing the Primavera global campaign; brand's own channel, so treated as activation coverage per sentiment-rubric discount rather than organic public opinion, though comment volume is a genuine buzz signal.
